description: This file exports types and functions related to bash tools, acting as an index or aggregator for various bash-tool modules such as bash-tools.exec, bash-tools.process, etc.

methods.name: createExecTool
methods.description: Creates an executable tool based on specified configuration.

methods.name: describeExecTool
methods.description: Provides a description of the executable tool.

methods.name: execTool
methods.description: Executes a bash tool with given parameters.

methods.name: createProcessTool
methods.description: Creates a process tool with specified defaults.

methods.name: describeProcessTool
methods.description: Provides a description of the process tool.
